# Trekon Mobile

> Mobile-first landing and blog for Trekon guided running workouts.

## Main pages

- https://mobile.trekon.run/
- https://mobile.trekon.run/contact
- https://mobile.trekon.run/blog

## Sitemap

- https://mobile.trekon.run/sitemap.xml

## Blog source

Articles are published as HTML and Markdown under `/blog/*.md` with index metadata at `/blog/index.json`.
